en.html:
Sayo"Hm? ...The air moving beyond this door has something peculiar about it."
Kageaki"Probably because of the hole I cut when I broke in."
Kanae"You came in here, Mr. Kageaki? Then surely this is no place for us to be wandering about?"
Kageaki"...That is entirely correct."

さよ 「はて？ 　……この扉の向こうは空気の流れが何やら 妙でございますな」
景明 「それはおそらく、自分が突入する際に斬り 開けた穴のためでしょう」
香奈枝 「ここから景明さまが？ 　でしたら、こんな所でうろうろしていては 危険なのではありませんこと？」
景明 「……全くもってその通りです」

en.html:
Those two escorts might already have returned.
The people aboard would also know where I had broken in.

What was I doing? Of all times to go half-asleep, why this one?

I gave up opening the door and turned back.

en.html:
I accepted it.
Here I would cross blades with an overwhelming number of enemy soldiers, and fall.

That would be my last assistance. The rest I could only entrust to Lady Kanae, who surely would not be as careless as I had been.
...I had wanted to be of a little more use.

Enough of that.
Swallowing my regret, I drew my sword.

ja.html:
観念した。
　ここで圧倒的な敵兵と切り結び、そして果てる。

　それをせめてもの援護とし、後は間違っても俺ほど
の迂闊者ではないだろう香奈枝嬢に望みを掛けるしか
ない。
　……もう少しは役に立ちたかったが。

　もはや言うまい。
　俺は無念を呑み、太刀を抜き放った。
